The '''Novi system''' was located in the [[Interior Region]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the [[Farnica system/Legends|Farnica]] and [[Gallinore system/Legends|Gallinore systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Novi [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstones]] known as [[Novian ruby/Legends|Novian rubies]].<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (1985) 2|''Ewoks'' (1985) 2]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Novian ruby/Legends|Novian rubies]]|system=Novi [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Novi system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
